channel.title: Speakers on DevFest Venezia 26
channel.description: Recent content in Speakers on DevFest Venezia 26

item.title: Alessia Bragagnolo
item.description: Software Engineer@Spotify. While I specialize in backend development, I’m always exploring new technologies and domains.

item.title: Alfredo Bautista Santos
item.description: Writing code down south, sometimes giving talks or organizing get-togethers. Flutter GDE. Co-organizer of @GDGMarbella and @flutterconfes. Front-end developer.

item.title: Ankur Roy
item.description: I am a Solutions Architect at Online Partner AB and a Cloud GDE. I have worked on several projects involving Google Cloud services and Google Workspace along with multiple other technology stacks and platforms.

item.title: Ceren Özgür
item.description: I am a Computer Engineer and a Master’s student in Data Analytics for Business and Society at Ca’ Foscari University of Venice. My interests are at the intersection of software engineering, artificial intelligence, and data analytics. I have experience in software development, AI driven applications, and data analysis, including working with technologies such as Python, .NET, and machine learning. I enjoy exploring new technologies and building practical solutions to real world problems.

item.title: Daniel Chenet
item.description: Software engineer con 8 anni di esperienza in ambito IoT. Coordina il team Platform presso Targa Telematics, dove si occupa dell’architettura e della scalabilità dei flussi di data ingestion. Lavora prevalentemente con Kotlin, Flink, Kafka e Cassandra.

item.title: Daniele Bonaldo
item.description:
Daniele is an Android developer passionate about photography, wearable technologies and Internet of Things.

Freelance developer, international conference speaker and Google Developer Expert, now he loves to work on everything related to the Android ecosystem, from Chromecast to Wear to smart mirrors.

item.title: Daniele De Marchi
item.description: Software Developer con 5 anni di esperienza sul campo. In Targa Telematics fa parte del team Platform, occupandosi di progettare, ottimizzare e scalare l’infrastruttura di data ingestion. Sviluppa principalmente in Kotlin e ama le architetture semplici ma efficaci. Il suo focus principale è garantire l’affidabilità dei sistemi di elaborazione e la qualità del codice.

item.title: Davide Bellone
item.description:
Davide Bellone is a Principal Backend Developer, Content Creator and Microsoft MVP.

He loves exploring new tools and libraries, going the extra mile in writing blog posts and delivering tech sessions.

He also runs Code4IT.dev, a tech blog where he publishes articles about .NET, Azure, Software Architecture, Testing, and other stuff that most Backend Developers will find interesting.

He’s one of the community leads of the Torino.NET User Group.

He’s the creator of the Testing Vial, a new testing strategy focused on describing entities to better understand the system.

item.title: Dominika Zając
item.description: Full-stack developer who loves sharing their knowledge and singing. Google Developer Expert for Web Technologies, Microsoft Most Valuable Professional in Web technologies, senior software engineer at Qualtrics, public speaker, trainer and blogger. Talking and writing about Web, a11y, teaching others how to code and code best practices.

item.title: Fabian Krumbholz
item.description:
Fabian has spent 25 years building fast, accessible websites – and now shows developers how to get that same quality out of AI tools.

He has optimised web technologies from the moment they shipped, always obsessing over one thing: how fast a page feels to the person actually using it. And no era comes close to how exciting this one is.

The new Google tools will build you an excellent website or a shockingly bad one — the difference is knowing what good looks like. YouTube shows you the demos. Fabian teaches the setup that produces the golden ones: accessible, fast, and running in every browser.

item.title: Gabriel Palmisano
item.description:
As a Mobile Developer at EBWorld and Maintainer of the MapLibre Flutter package, I am expert in developing mobile applications with advanced mapping. My mission is to bring geospatial data out of the office: I develop apps in Flutter that transform complex infrastructures (such as electrical networks or aqueducts) into essential operational tools for those who work physically in the field.

I have been writing code since I was very young, driven by a curiosity to explore the limits of the technologies I use. In addition to my work at EBWorld, I actively contribute to open source to improve the tools that developers rely on every day. As a speaker, I love bringing real-world use cases to the stage, translating complex architectural challenges into practical solutions for the community.

item.title: Giorgio Basile
item.description: I am a young man born in 2000 and I am currently finishing my studies in computer science at the Ca’ Foscari University of Venice, located in Mestre, in addition to being a full-time web developer. In addition to studying, I love playing role-playing games, skateboarding and playing Magic the Gathering.

item.title: Giulia Scalaberni
item.description: Giulia began her journey as a web dev, moved to data analyst and today she’s a product manager of a BI tool in an IT healthcare company, leading remote Scrum teams with members from 8 different cultures, starting from India. She’s relentlessly people‐centric, fascinated by how diverse cultures interact and always reading and exploring differences to make teamwork more “human”. When she’s not shaping product strategy or pondering team dynamics, you’ll find her at concerts imagining the tour management behind the scenes, or with a plane ticket already booked - Osaka and Lisbon are her places of the heart. She’s hopelessly obsessed with bubble tea, loves kangaroos and shares honest storytelling and practical insights that anyone can steal and use tomorrow.

item.title: Israel Blancas
item.description:
From Granada (Spain). Google Developer Expert in Google Cloud and GDG Organizer. Always trying to learn and sharing with the community.

I spend my time working on the OpenTelemetry project! Do you want to learn more? Ping me!

item.title: István Juhos
item.description: Staff Android Engineer @ Circuit; Co-organizer of Android Budapest

item.title: Ivan Morgillo
item.description: Passionate developer, speaker, writer, and 1/2 of Code with the Italians

item.title: Leonardo Gazzola
item.description: He graduated in Computer Science from Ca’ Foscari University of Venice and currently works as an IIoT Support Engineer at Galdi. He is interested in networking, software development, and Industrial IoT, with experience in troubleshooting and connected industrial environments.

item.title: Luca Del Puppo
item.description:
I’m a Senior Software Engineer, Google Developer Expert, former Microsoft MVP, Codemotion Ambassador and GitKraken Ambassador. I love JavaScript and TypeScript.

In my free time, I love studying new technologies, improving myself, creating YouTube content or writing technical articles. I can’t stay without trail running and love to do it in my beloved Dolomiti.

item.title: Luca Raveri
item.description:
I’m a Software Engineer focused on backend development, cloud architecture, and observability.

I thrive in high-impact, fast-paced environments where I can take full ownership, especially in startups.

I help companies grow their products from early ideas into reliable platforms used by thousands of users, building scalable backend systems and secure cloud infrastructure.

item.title: Luiz Carneiro
item.description: Luiz Carneiro is a Senior Solution Engineer at smapiot GmbH and a Google Developer Expert (GDE) for Cloud & AI. With a PhD in Physics, Luiz combines deep technical expertise with a passion for making complex topics accessible. Regarding community contributions, he leads the GDG Cloud Munich, a community with 2.6k+ members. That last means a long track record leading, organizing, and facilitating technical community events, talks, and workshops, with a primary focus on Cloud and AI.

item.title: Marco Biondo
item.description:
IIoT & SW Engineer @ Galdi, working on industrial systems with a particular focus on edge computing.

In the last few years, he has been exploring Rust through real-world IIoT projects, evaluating its use in production-grade edge systems.

His work focuses on bringing modern cloud-native practices, such as Kubernetes, GitOps, and observability, into industrial edge environments where systems have traditionally been designed to remain unchanged for years. This approach enables industrial systems to evolve more safely and reliably over time, while supporting growing cybersecurity requirements around continuous maintenance, patching, and software updates.

item.title: Matteo Valerio
item.description:
I’m a full-stack developer with 5+ years of experience building and evolving web applications across both startup and enterprise environments. I currently work at Air (Connected Mobility), where I focus on Node.js, React, and TypeScript-based systems.

I’m particularly interested in understanding and improving existing codebases, especially APIs, and in navigating the real-world trade-offs behind system evolution.

I also contribute as a technical content author for Hyperskill (JetBrains Academy).

item.title: Nejmeddine Ben Ouarred
item.description:
My name is Nejmeddine BEN OUARRED, known as Nej.

I am a Google Developer Expert (GDE) in Cloud Infrastructure and an Authorized Google trainer. I have 7 active Google Cloud certifications and Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD) certification (see the complete list of certifications below).

I am a consultant specialisied in digital and technological strategy.

I work with French, European and International companies on topics related to Google Cloud and also on projects involving APIs.

item.title: Rachele Bari
item.description:
Appassionata di innovazione tecnologica e comunicazione digitale, lavora da oltre 10 anni nel mondo Digital e IT, con un background che parte dalla consulenza e dall’account management fino ad arrivare alla specializzazione in ambito HR tech.

Specializzata nella ricerca e selezione di profili Digital & IT e sulla consulenza strategica per aziende in fase di trasformazione digitale, affianca realtà tech e team di sviluppo nella costruzione di ambienti di lavoro efficaci, lavorando a stretto contatto con le aziende per far crescere team solidi e attrarre i talenti giusti per scalare progetti e adottare nuove tecnologie. Il focus di Rachele: creare connessioni concrete tra aziende e persone candidate, favorendo team solidi, innovativi e pronti a sostenere le sfide del digitale.

item.title: Rainer Hahnekamp
item.description:
Rainer Hahnekamp is co-founder and AI Engineer at Soverius AI, and a Google Developer Expert (GDE), with fifteen years building mission-critical enterprise systems.

He specializes in local LLMs and everything it takes to run them in production - the harness and loop engineering, retrieval, and agentic systems that turn a local model into something a company can depend on, with its data and source code never leaving the building.

Rainer has an academic foundation in Unsupervised Machine Learning from the University of Vienna.

item.title: Rowdy Rabouw
item.description: Rowdy Rabouw is a Google Developer Expert in Web Technologies with over 25 years of experience in HTML, CSS and JavaScript. Currently, he works as a Front-End-Focused Senior DevOps Engineer on Vue, Node, and NestJS projects, with a focus on usability and accessibility. Rowdy loves his electronic drum kit and dabbles in creating music on his laptop.

item.title: Soumaya Erradi
item.description: I’m an experienced web developer and a passionate IT and electronics trainer, specializing in frontend development and enterprise applications built with Angular. I spend most of my time exploring what’s new in the tech world and helping other developers improve their skills. As a conference speaker, I bring advanced Angular topics, tips for the integration of smart contracts and best solutions for web3 applications.

item.title: Susanna Wong
item.description:
Susanna is a Staff Software Engineer passionate about all web technologies, and engineering excellence in the adoption of AI.

She has been a software developer with experience spanning across multiple industries, from small agile teams in big corporates ( CNN, Toyota Connected, FairFX, McKinsey/QB) to early stage startups, with extensive experience in web development (React, Ember, Angular, PWAs), GraphQL, and all things GenAI.

Susanna is currently a Staff engineer at Typeform, working at the realms of building products in cutting edge AI.

item.title: Tarik Huber
item.description: Tarik is an self-taught developer who went from Basic on Desktop through Java for Android to Javascript for the Web and ended up as a huge PWA enthusiast. As such he is using Firebase and the latest web tech to solve all problems that come in front of him during his work at a logistics company. He believes that open source is the future of development so he made all his company libraries open source. Through his work as organiser of GDG Berchtesgadener Land and External Lecturer at Salzburg - University of Applied Sciences he tries to teach more people about modern web technologies.
